mira: quick finalization thread 18m webinar runbook: title idea 'Predictable Inference: real knobs for latency & cost'
cole: love it. keep it pragmatic. speakers: cole (decision flow 4m), anya (demo 10m), ravi (benchmarks + routing 3m), mira (close 1m)
anya: demo plan: small chat -> rerank pass. will pre-warm KV cache and record a 30s fallback video. will not use real customer data.
mira: run-of-show (18m strict):
- 0:00-0:00:45 - welcome & housekeeping (mira)
- 0:00:45-0:04:15 - when to pick Hosted / Dedicated / Private (cole)
- 0:04:15-0:14:15 - live demo: chat + rerank (anya)
- 0:14:15-0:17:15 - benchmarks, best-practices, routing rules (ravi)
- 0:17:15-0:18:00 - CTA + lead routing note (mira)
cole: routing rule draft: demo requests or intent >=2k tokens/mo -> AE, else SDR. add checkbox 'regulated' to route to enterprise.
ravi: benchmark notes: include p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, and $/1M tokens for Hosted vs Dedicated. keep visuals minimal.
anya: pre-warm example I'll use: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/instances/prewarm -d '{"model":"demo-chat","seq":128}'`
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: rehearsal booked Wed 09:30-10:00 PT in #marketing-rehearsals
mira: rehearsal checklist: mic test, screen share order, demo creds in vault, pre-warm, fallback clip queued, backup laptop. ACK?
cole: ack 1 will draft the one-slide decision visual and ping design for light/dark variants.
ravi: ack 1 will prepare the benchmark slide and lead CSV mapping.
anya: ack 1 will upload fallback video and demo creds to the vault before rehearsal.
mira: perfect. social should call out the practical checklist + rerank demo. ops-bot: follow-up template created: https://confluence.redwood.ai/marketing/webinar-mini-followup
mira: thanks team 1 we'll run dry run Wed and go live Thu.
